meta.title: Sundial
meta.key: F Lydian: Fmaj9, Gadd9, Am7, Cadd9
meta.words: v2: the vibraphone is now native (an aluminium bar and its tremolo); otherwise as v1. Lydian, open and bright: F major 9, G add 9, A minor 7, C add 9, two bars each. A kalimba arpeggio, the vibraphone on long notes, the round Detroit bass, the glass pad, ride-bell accents.
